# Loadout Rank

> Ranked AI tools by use case (8 categories, 10 tools each) plus a dated list of recent AI releases. Scores are provisional editorial seed scores as of 2026-10-27.

Key facts: updated 2026-10-27; weights planned Quality 40 / Adoption 20 / Value 15 / Ease 15 / Trust 10; no affiliate or sponsored links currently.
Publisher: Loadout Rank, independent (not affiliated with any listed tool); official X account: https://x.com/LoadoutRank

## Main
- [Rankings (Markdown, citable)](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/rankings.md): all rankings, scores, release list with dates and sources
- [Rankings (HTML)](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/): same data with per-category anchors
- [Methodology & disclosure](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/about.html)
- [Head-to-head comparisons index](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/comparisons.html)
- [Full text for LLMs](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/llms-full.txt): every ranking, the release list, and each comparison's verdict, pick-if guidance, price/feature table and sources in one Markdown file
- [Structured data (JSON)](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/data.json): every tool (category, rank, score, url) and every release (date, org, type, primary-source url, entry anchor and absolute permalink to our entry); same facts as the pages, updated 2026-10-27
